en.text: Tom doesn't believe me at all.

original: バカなことを言ってしまった。

en.text: I said something stupid.

original: 仕事が見つからないって、ぶちぶち言ってたよ。

en.text: He complained about not finding work.

original: 私は何を言っているのか理解できなかった。

en.text: I really couldn't understand what was being said.

original: 父さんがいつも言ってたことなんだ。

en.text: That's what my dad always said.

original: 自分が言ったこと、覚えてる？

en.text: Do you remember what you said?

original: あの人の言ってること、よくわかんないんだけど。

en.text: I didn't really catch what that person was saying.

original: やっぱり、彼が言ったことは正しかった。

en.text: What he said was actually true.

original: これは英語で何て言うの？

en.text: How do you say this in English?

original: うそを言うな！

en.text: Don't lie!

original: 誰にも言わないよね？

en.text: You won't tell anyone, will you?

original: 警察に嘘を言った。

en.text: I lied to the cops.
I lied to the police.

original: よいものを読んだ後、何も書くな、何も言うな、お前は、その美しい恍惚を、お前の汚れた言葉で汚す恥知らずを敢てするな。

en.text: After reading something beautiful, write nothing, say nothing; do not be so shameless as to sully that exquisite rapture with your filthy words.

original: 愛してるって、言ったじゃん。

en.text: You said you loved me.

original: 母さんには言わないで。

en.text: Please don't tell Mom.

original: また会える時は言うよ。

en.text: When we are able to meet again I will talk with you.

original: いいえ、言ってないわ。

en.text: No, that's not what I'm saying.
No, I'm not saying that.

indices: いいえ(#1583250)[01] 言う{言ってない} わ

original: 簡単な言葉で言ってみて。

en.text: Try and say things using simple words.
Try saying it with simple words.

original: わがままばかり言わないの！

en.text: You shouldn't just be selfish!
You shouldn't just say selfish things!
You shouldn't just whine!

original: 彼女に言わないことにした。

en.text: I decided not to tell her.

original: どうしてOKって、言ったの？

en.text: Why did you say OK?

original: 嘘も方便って、言うでしょ？

en.text: It's said that 'the ends justify the means', right?
It's said that 'a lie is convenient', right?

original: いまの、真顔で言ってみて。

en.text: Now try saying that with a straight face.
